faq.question: What makes a chair good for small spaces?
faq.answer: A smaller footprint, the ability to tuck under a shallow desk, breathable materials that do not visually dominate the room, and enough adjustability for your desk height. Oversized gaming chairs usually fail the first two tests.

faq.question: Do I need a fully adjustable ergonomic chair in a studio?
faq.answer: If you work long days, yes—prioritize seat height and lumbar support. If you only need short sessions and maximum floor clearance, a compact armless task chair can be the smarter small-space choice.

faq.question: Should I buy the chair or the desk first?
faq.answer: Measure both together. In apartments, desk depth and chair tuck-under clearance are one system. If footprint is the tighter constraint, lock the desk depth first, then choose a chair that fits under it.

faq.question: Are armless chairs okay for full workdays?
faq.answer: They are excellent for space, but weaker for all-day support. Use an armless chair when tuck-under clearance is the priority; choose a compact ergonomic chair with adjustable lumbar for heavy remote-work days.
